title: Chapter 606 - 606 Granny Tree Demon; Nie Xiaoqian?
content:
Chapter 606 - 606 Granny Tree Demon; Nie Xiaoqian?

Chapter 606 - 606 Granny Tree Demon; Nie Xiaoqian?

606 Granny Tree Demon; Nie Xiaoqian?

Sam felt the endless energy in his body and was at a loss.

“Thank you, Master!” he said excitedly after a while.

Lin Fan did not reply. Instead, he looked ahead.

Perhaps, it was because killing the level-eight Hellwater had caused too much of a commotion.

Ten monsters that were about two meters tall, wearing bronze armor and holding long halberds, rushed over from afar.

Their eyes were scarlet, and their bodies were filled with a murderous aura.

It was awe-inspiring and terrifying.

Lin Fan muttered, “There are jars and armored warriors? There should have been people living in the Otherworld before, right?”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan’s palm shook gently.

The flaming longsword that had yet to dissipate transformed into a beautiful sword flower in the air.

The bronze-armored warriors that were charging at them shattered like bubbles.

Only the smoke and dust in the air proved that they had appeared not long ago.

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded.

[The first to kill a level-six Armored Battle Team. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-six Armored Battle Team. An energy mine has appeared in Hua Nation.]

Lin Fan opened the treasure chest in front of him.

[You’ve obtained 600 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—6,000 points of spiritual energy.]

Lin Fan’s entire body felt refreshed, and his thoughts were extremely clear.

Then, he said to the Heavenly Hound, “Use these 600 points of spiritual energy.”

The Heavenly Hound placed its paw on the ball of light.

The ball of light circled around the Heavenly Hound once before entering its body.

Instantly, the Heavenly Hound’s eyes flashed with a faint light.

It was also at this moment that another emotionless voice appeared at the scene.

[First to help a level-seven Heavenly Hound reach level eight. You’ve obtained a level-four treasure chest.]

[First to help a level-seven Heavenly Hound reach level eight. Hua Nation’s pollution has reduced by 10%.]

Lin Fan did not expect to get another treasure chest. He opened it casually.

[You’ve obtained 200 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

Instantly, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—2,000 Constitution points.]

His strength rose again.

Lin Fan said to the Heavenly Hound, “Use these 200 Constitution points.”

After all, he had already obtained 2,000 Constitution points because of the Heavenly Hound.

These 200 Constitution points would be the Heavenly Hound’s reward.

The Heavenly Hound did not hesitate and placed its paw on the ball of light.

Its white fur shook, and its strength increased.

The enemies in front had been wiped out. Lin Fan did not have any intention of staying there.

The two people and the dog walked forward at a brisk pace.

The sky gradually darkened.

At this moment, a large bird flew over the treetops above their heads.

Lin Fan willed.

[Skill: Gravity Control!]

The giant bird fell to the ground as if it had been crushed by a mountain.

Sam had seen similar situations several times.

Therefore, he was not surprised.

He seized the time to gather firewood and prepare to roast the meat.

In the past, there were many dead trees on the ground.

However, today, Sam searched for a long time but could not find a single dead tree.

While Sam was trying to find the dead wood, he did not notice that a branch behind him suddenly shook.

No!

It was not just one branch, but all the branches shook.

Then, the branches surrounded Sam like tentacles.

The Heavenly Hound in the distance barked.

Then, it charged forward and cut off all the branches with his sharp claws.

Lin Fan heard the noise and walked over.

At this moment, all the surrounding trees seemed to have come alive. They kept shaking, and their branches danced wildly.

In fact…

Not only did the branches around Lin Fan shake, but when night fell, all the trees in the forbidden area came alive.

Sam had the Heavenly Hound block the branches. They did not dare to act rashly.

The others who were also in the forbidden area were not so lucky.

Some people were hung in the air by tree branches.

Someone was wrapped up like a dumpling.

Some people were chased by the branches and fled quickly.

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

“Oh, my god!” the host exclaimed in surprise. “What happened? This mustn’t be true! I actually saw all the trees move.”

Mike: [Host, you’re not mistaken. The big trees are indeed moving.]

Allen: [This is too strange!]

Henry Fett: [Oh, no! Our hero is entangled by a tree branch, and he can’t break free!]

MMM: [Someone save him!]

…

Eagle Country’s live broadcast room.

Phoebus: [What is this place?]

FF: [Those trees are like terrifying monsters.]

8888: [No! He was caught!]

…

Compared to the shock and uneasiness of the other countries, the scene in Hua Nation’s live broadcast room was very different.

Whose Youth is Not Lost: [Tree demons? Are they all tree demons?]

Shan Ye: [There are so many tree demons. Could there be a granny tree demon?]

Wind: [Granny tree demon? Wouldn’t that mean that Nie Xiaoqian might be involved?]

Flower: [I wonder if Nie Xiaoqian from the Otherworld is good-looking.]

…

Who would have thought that the Hua audience would not be nervous or worried at all in such a critical moment?

Instead, they were concerned about Nie Xiaoqian.

It was because they believed in Lin Fan’s strength. They believed that he would not be in danger.

The truth was just as everyone had expected.

Lin Fan looked at the swaying trees and muttered, “During the day, these trees don’t move… Do they only move at night?”

Just as Lin Fan was muttering to himself, the surrounding branches turned into tentacles once more and pounced toward Lin Fan.

“Are you in such a hurry?” Lin Fan hollered and pulled out his sword.

[Sword 1: Draw the sword and slash the heavens!]

Several rays of light flashed, and the branches that flew over were all broken.

The surrounding trees were almost all bald.

However, the surface of these bald branches emitted a ray of light, and at a speed visible to the naked eye, dense branches grew out.

At the same time, the energy in Lin Fan, Sam, and the Heavenly Hound’s bodies suddenly decreased.

Lin Fan said, “So it can absorb the energy of others to replenish itself?

“Looks like… we need to end this quickly.

“Fire is more suitable for restraining trees.”

As the sound of his voice faded, Lin Fan’s entire body was engulfed in flames, lighting up the dark sky.

Lin Fan picked up the Star Meteorite Sword and waved it in the air.

In the next moment, all the flames suddenly gathered and condensed, turning into countless fire swords hovering in the air.

“Go!” Lin Fan said softly.

[Sword 9: 10,000 swords strike together!]
